Hepatic venous outflow obstruction defines a vascular liver disease. Congestive splenomegaly alone does not establish blood-organ damage; renal and neurologic complications are <30%.
Benign adipose neoplasm located in the central nervous system; adipose histology does not establish skin involvement.
